title: A Sentence, Nailed Up
text:
By order of the Wax Synod: the bearer of this notice is found guilty of Colour, of Hoarding Flame, and of Singing in the Nave after Compline.

The sentence is Penance by Powder. The bearer is to walk the Pilgrim's Road until the Tallow Mother is appeased or the bearer is spent.

Someone has scratched underneath: they never say how long it takes. It takes as long as you last.
